selection: Highest nominal expected-return H/D/A selection, then require probability * decimal odds > 1 + cutoff. No quoted-odds restriction. No substitution when the selected outcome fails.
sizing: Flat $1, quarter Kelly, robust quarter Kelly with a 0.02 probability reduction. Nominal return gate before robust sizing. 2% match / 10% daily cash caps; same-day stakes reserved before settlement. Independent $1000 per simulation.
interpretation: Sensitivity comparison only; does not select or change the active 2% cutoff. Frozen chronological CV choices, same fixtures, no refitting. Previously inspected 2021-22 audit and 2022-23 test. Historical Bet365 odds; no fees or rounding. Best realized cutoff is a hindsight result.
